integrity: Shannon comparisons are reduced exactly to integer products and Simpson comparisons to integer collision sums. The complete abundance-partition domains through seven individuals are generated independently by recursive partitions and by canonicalized compositions, with exact agreement and an exact replay of every boundary pair.
scientific_limitations: The theorem compares Shannon diversity with the finite-sample Simpson diversity convention on positive integer abundance profiles at fixed total census size. It is a smallest-census ordering classification and does not address sampling uncertainty, detectability, or other diversity indices.
title: Six individuals split Shannon and Simpson; seven reverse them
